explanation: Move inward from both ends, skipping non-alphanumeric characters. Compare the remaining characters after invariant case folding, and reject at the first unequal pair.
timeComplexity: O(n) time. Each index moves inward at most n positions, including skipped punctuation.
spaceComplexity: O(1) auxiliary space. Only indices and temporary normalized characters are stored.
attribution: Original C# implementation and explanation authored for EPI Practice from the displayed problem contract.
correctness: Skipping non-alphanumeric characters preserves precisely the sequence the contract asks to compare. The remaining two-pointer comparisons check mirrored members of that sequence after case normalization, so all and only normalized palindromes are accepted.
walkthrough: For "R2, r!", ignore the comma, space and exclamation mark and normalize R to r. The remaining sequence is "r2r", whose mirrored letters agree, so return true.
edgeCases: A string containing only ignored characters is a palindrome.
Mixed letter case is normalized before comparing.
Character positions in this implementation are UTF-16 code units, not user-perceived grapheme clusters.
